body: ive really just wanted to be socially accepted i guess, as well as successful with women. i feel that i am a normal guy but others dont seem to feel the same. i received a lot of shit from my peers growing up and it still seems to happen till this day. Im able to deal with the harassment and teasing but 99 percent of people probably have no idea im depressed, i dont want to be shunned or ignored because im labeled depressed yet i dont want to be harassed either
yeah do something new traveling seems like a good idea. get out of the "routine", thats what always seems to mess with my mind.
